articles.title: Asian Stocks to Dip as Oil Fuels Inflation Worries: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: A global stock rally that brought equities within striking distance of an all-time high lost further ground as oil jumped on renewed Middle East tensions, stoking concerns about inflation. Treasuries declined.
